design.generation: Fresh agent per arm; no primary outputs or grades disclosed. Same reference information and task contracts. Write source with PowerShell WriteAllText and UTF8 encoding directly to WSL UNC, never native-pipe source text. One implementation per family. No test access or execution.
design.primary: All 6 frozen fixtures pass per program, 3 programs per arm. Report per-family case counts, exceptions, and check failures; 54 executions are not 54 independent generations.
hypotheses: Does supplying concrete recorded risks improve objective implementation correctness over complete existing methods?
Does regrouping the exact same reports by stored outcome_id improve correctness over original report arrays?
design.strong_baseline: Identical complete current contracts plus existing method cautions. No stripping warnings or withholding requirements to manufacture gain.
design.source_scope: Three deliberately selected public controlled examples; SQLite FK risk and search misses, join is a successful risk audit rather than a failed implementation.
controls: All records manually selected: no retrieval or graph navigation efficacy measured.
Raw and linked experiences contain exactly identical full objects; linked regrouping only follows explicit outcome_id.
No private experiences, credentials, actual bank data, or real customer fixtures.
No inference of human utility, billing savings, generalization, statistical significance or model-family superiority.
Requested model label available; actual backend identity and billed usage may be unavailable and remain null.
design.pre_generation_correction: Draft harness Korean strings were found corrupted in transport; corrected before protocol freeze or candidate generation. Draft preserved privately in runtime, not an experimental output.
design.followup_reason: Primary 17/18,17/18,18/18 differs only on Korean particle case; observed source files show method_only double-escaped Unicode and raw_experience question-mark suffix corruption. Preserve original outputs; regenerate ALL arms fresh with one shared reliable file transport. No per-output repairs. This uses previously evaluated fixtures, not a new holdout.

comparison: Manually selected existing public method versus added real stored synthetic-example reports versus exact same reports regrouped by outcome_id. No independent retrieval comparison.
limits: Three selected families, one implementation per arm and family. Six fixtures per program are clustered checks, not independent generations.
All arms already receive complete task contracts and baseline method caveats; ceiling effects possible.
Prior join case is successful risk detection, not an observed failed join. Backups expose FK inconsistency; search prior cases include actual misses.
No private or real customer data; examples are synthetic. No measured user benefit, reviewer time, actual billing or statistical superiority.
One agent generates three programs within each arm; within-arm context carryover possible. Requested model label is not independently verified backend identity.
Exact same experience objects and no additional claims in linked arm. This is packaging, not graph reasoning.
